Care for the Westbank, close to home

West Jefferson Medical Center is a 324-bed not-for-profit hospital on Medical Center Boulevard in Marrero. For more than 60 years it has been the regional hospital for Jefferson, Orleans, Plaquemines, and St. Charles Parish communities on the Westbank.

Patients come here for emergency care, heart and vascular treatment, cancer services, maternity care at The Family Birth Place, orthopedics, imaging, and a full range of hospital specialties. Neighborhood primary care clinics extend that same LCMC Health team into Algiers, Harvey, Gretna, and Terrytown.

fields.Detail:
A community hospital for the Westbank

West Jefferson Medical Center opened in April 1960 after Westbank families and physicians organized one of the first hospitals on this side of the river. Today it is a 324-bed not-for-profit hospital on a campus of more than 20 acres in Marrero, minutes from downtown New Orleans.

The hospital is a regional leader in acute, preventive, and rehabilitative care for Jefferson, Orleans, Plaquemines, and St. Charles Parish communities. On campus, patients find emergency services paired with heart and vascular care, a Joint Commission Comprehensive Stroke Center, bone and joint care, diagnostic imaging, a Commission on Cancer-accredited cancer program, comprehensive women's services, and a CARF-certified rehabilitation program.

Mission, vision, and values

  • Mission: Health, care, and education beyond extraordinary.
  • Vision: Creating a culture of wellness.
  • Values: We bring heart and soul. We're in it together. We give a little extra.

Part of LCMC Health

West Jefferson joined LCMC Health in 2015. As a member of the New Orleans-based nonprofit system, the hospital continues to serve Westbank industry, maritime corridors, and neighborhood families with the same local commitment that opened its doors more than 60 years ago.
